transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot make calibrated decisions without knowing the true scale of spread and severity — surge testing is the single highest-value action in week one.

actions.rationale: We cannot make calibrated decisions without knowing the true scale of spread and severity — surge testing is the single highest-value action in week one.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Slowing importation buys days-to-weeks of lead time at low economic cost while we assess the threat.

actions.rationale: Slowing importation buys days-to-weeks of lead time at low economic cost while we assess the threat.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Invoking the DPA now prevents supply-chain bottlenecks for PPE, tests, and ventilators before demand spikes — lead times are long and waiting is costly.

actions.rationale: Invoking the DPA now prevents supply-chain bottlenecks for PPE, tests, and ventilators before demand spikes — lead times are long and waiting is costly.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has an 12–18 month horizon; every week of delay compounds — we must start the clock immediately regardless of how the threat assessment evolves.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has an 12–18 month horizon; every week of delay compounds — we must start the clock immediately regardless of how the threat assessment evolves.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Transparent, data-driven communication builds the public trust we will need to make any future measures effective, and prevents panic born of rumor.

actions.rationale: Transparent, data-driven communication builds the public trust we will need to make any future measures effective, and prevents panic born of rumor.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Emergency funding authority and economic relief tools require Congressional action; starting that process now prevents a legislative lag if the crisis escalates.

actions.rationale: Emergency funding authority and economic relief tools require Congressional action; starting that process now prevents a legislative lag if the crisis escalates.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 57/100. Hospital strain 7/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 19/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: A federal mask mandate is a low-cost, high-upside intervention that reduces transmission regardless of final severity without imposing major economic damage.

actions.rationale: A federal mask mandate is a low-cost, high-upside intervention that reduces transmission regardless of final severity without imposing major economic damage.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Targeting protections on the elderly and high-risk delivers the greatest life-saving benefit per dollar of disruption at this stage, regardless of whether severity proves high or low.

actions.rationale: Targeting protections on the elderly and high-risk delivers the greatest life-saving benefit per dollar of disruption at this stage, regardless of whether severity proves high or low.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard will raise public trust from its fragile 57/100 baseline and give governors the real-time information they need to calibrate their own responses.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard will raise public trust from its fragile 57/100 baseline and give governors the real-time information they need to calibrate their own responses.

actions.name: defer_to_states

params.rationale: With severity still deeply uncertain and hospital strain low, governors are better positioned to calibrate local restrictions — federal support without federal overreach preserves cooperation and credibility.

actions.rationale: With severity still deeply uncertain and hospital strain low, governors are better positioned to calibrate local restrictions — federal support without federal overreach preserves cooperation and credibility.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Priming the economic relief pipeline now prevents legislative lag if the crisis escalates, and stabilizes household and small-business confidence in affected cities immediately.

actions.rationale: Priming the economic relief pipeline now prevents legislative lag if the crisis escalates, and stabilizes household and small-business confidence in affected cities immediately.

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: With the infection index tripling to 3.0 and spread now confirmed across a dozen states, voluntary measures alone cannot bend the curve — strong federal guidance is needed now before hospital strain becomes irreversible, even while severity remains uncertain.

actions.rationale: With the infection index tripling to 3.0 and spread now confirmed across a dozen states, voluntary measures alone cannot bend the curve — strong federal guidance is needed now before hospital strain becomes irreversible, even while severity remains uncertain.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Resolving the 'bad flu vs. catastrophic' uncertainty is still the highest analytical priority — better data this week directly determines whether we need to escalate or can ease off.

actions.rationale: Resolving the 'bad flu vs. catastrophic' uncertainty is still the highest analytical priority — better data this week directly determines whether we need to escalate or can ease off.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: The public must understand the R=3.0 acceleration and the multi-state cluster spread so that federal guidance has legitimacy and voluntary compliance is high — trust at 59 is fragile and honesty is the only way to protect it.

actions.rationale: The public must understand the R=3.0 acceleration and the multi-state cluster spread so that federal guidance has legitimacy and voluntary compliance is high — trust at 59 is fragile and honesty is the only way to protect it.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With spread now nationwide, reinforcing targeted protection of the elderly and high-risk is critical to keeping the death toll low while broader interventions take effect.

actions.rationale: With spread now nationwide, reinforcing targeted protection of the elderly and high-risk is critical to keeping the death toll low while broader interventions take effect.
